text: Michelin's own group page describes a multi-brand strategy: in addition to MICHELIN, its primary brand, the Group's portfolio currently comprises more than 120 other brands in the tire sector.
short: Michelin runs a multi-brand portfolio of more than 120 brands besides MICHELIN.
